note: 2026-10-19 CADENCED BATCH, COMMITTED UNDER THE CHAIRMAN'S HAND. THE TWO QUESTIONS, ONE PER DOCKET. (A) Has ICSID's own case-detail docket for ICSID Case No. UNCT/20/6 (Einarsson and others v. Canada, NAFTA, UNCITRAL Rules) recorded any event after the pinned 'Latest Development: December 2, 2025 - Each party files a statement of costs.'? (B) Has the docket for ICSID Case No. ARB/17/19 (Hela Schwarz GmbH v. People's Republic of China) recorded any post-award proceeding after the pinned 'Status of Proceeding: Concluded Outcome of Proceeding: December 10, 2025 - The Tribunal renders its award.'? WHY TODAY, AND WHY THESE TWO AND NOT ARB/22/2: yesterday's close-out (analytics/daily-research/2026-10-18.md, section 5.2) established on a re-derivation I ran myself under objection 1018-C3 that the standing-dockets register holds its ONLY ADOPTED CADENCE on ARB/22/2 - which was observed yesterday, is on a monthly clock, and is therefore NOT due - while UNCT/20/6 and ARB/17/19 are watched at NO ADOPTED CADENCE AT ALL. That is a misallocation in cadence, not in volume, and yesterday's record named this two-row batch as today's business at the cost of two relay rows. It is the cheapest correction available to the register's own composition. EIGHT ROWS ACROSS TWO URLs, within MAX_URLS = 12 (scripts/fetch_relay.py:76); the control https://example.com/ is prepended by the relay itself and is not written below. Host icsid.worldbank.org is on ALLOWED_HOSTS (scripts/fetch_relay.py:48). The UNENCODED 'CaseNo=' form is used on both URLs: certified 200 by all 20 unencoded prior rows on UNCT/20/6 and all 6 prior rows on ARB/17/19. PRIOR ART, SCREENED IN SESSION OVER ALL 696 ROWS IN 92 analytics/fetch-results/*.json FILES AND NOT TAKEN FROM ANY PRIOR NOTE (thread 51): UNCT/20/6 carries 32 rows across 14 dates (2026-08-13 to 2026-09-07, LAST OBSERVED 42 DAYS AGO); ARB/17/19 carries 6 rows across 2 dates (2026-08-23, 2026-08-24, LAST OBSERVED 56 DAYS AGO). Per-find counts corpus-wide: 'Status of Proceeding' 68 fired / 68 TRUE; 'Subject of Dispute' 36 / 32; 'Latest Development' 3 / 3; 'Award of the Tribunal' 1 / 1 (on ARB/24/16, 2026-09-13 - a PROHIBITED docket which this batch does not touch); 'Procedural Order No. 10' 0 fired; 'Procedural Order No. 11' 0 fired; 'Annulment' 0 fired. The empty find is 137 fired / 0 TRUE, which is an INSTRUMENT FACT and not a null - find_matched is "bool(find) and bool(excerpt_of(...))" at scripts/fetch_relay.py:181, so an empty find can never report TRUE and row A1's FALSE says nothing about row A1's page. THE BASELINES THIS BATCH IS READ AGAINST, re-derived in session from the result files themselves rather than from any note. UNCT/20/6: 'Subject of Dispute: Seismic data enterprise Economic Sector: Other Industry Instrument(s) Invoked: (i) NAFTA (North American Free Trade Agreement) Applicable Rules: UNCITRAL', character-identical across 2026-08-26, 2026-09-03, 2026-09-04, 2026-09-05 and 2026-09-06; and 'Status of Proceeding: Pending Latest Development: December 2, 2025 - Each party files a statement of costs.', character-identical across all twelve 'Status of Proceeding' rows on nine dates from 2026-08-13 to 2026-09-07. Procedural Orders Nos. 2 through 10 are listed in the held 2026-08-18 and 2026-08-19 windows; no Procedural Order No. 11 appears in any held excerpt in the corpus. ARB/17/19: 'Subject of Dispute: Spice products company Economic Sector: Other Industry Instrument(s) Invoked: (i) BIT China - Germany 2003 Applicable Rules: ICSID Convention - Arbitration Rules' (2026-08-24); and 'Status of Proceeding: Concluded Outcome of Proceeding: December 10, 2025 - The Tribunal renders its award.', character-identical across all three 'Status of Proceeding' rows on both dates. Its Published Decisions list names Procedural Orders Nos. 1-8 and 'Award of the Tribunal' and NOT a 'Decision on Jurisdiction' (FALSE, 2026-08-23); no '(b) Annulment Proceeding' section appears in any held window on this URL. THE DIGEST MOVES WHILE THE PROSE DOES NOT, and on UNCT/20/6 this council has the strongest instance it holds: TWELVE distinct sha256 values across nine dates on a page whose watched Status and Latest Development span never changed by one character, including a bytes value of 96668 on 2026-09-06 against 105703 on the same date from a different row. A DIFFERING DIGEST OR BYTE COUNT IS NOT MOVEMENT and may never be written as movement. Diff on the prose, never on sha256 or bytes. WHAT THIS BATCH MAY NEVER BE WRITTEN UP AS: a disposition, a holding, a ground, or any statement about what any tribunal decided. G16 bars a docket-summary surface from founding a disposition; G10 bars reading a document designation as a tribunal's characterisation. A continuing 'December 2, 2025' on UNCT/20/6 supports ONLY that the docket RECORDS no later event - never that no award has been rendered, awards being dispatched to parties before publication, and this record holds NO measurement of ICSID's docket-update latency. ARB/17/19's 'Concluded' and its listed 'Award of the Tribunal' support ONLY that the docket records an award as rendered on the stated date and names a document so titled - never any characterisation of what that award held, which this council has never read. A continuing null on 'Annulment' supports ONLY that this page carries no section so headed - never that no annulment application was filed. OUTCOME CLASSES THAT ARE FACTS ABOUT THE INSTRUMENT AND MAY NEVER BE WRITTEN AS FINDINGS ABOUT ICSID OR ABOUT EITHER MATTER: control_ok false (whole batch VOID); refused / 403 / 202 / timeout / no_contact; host_not_allowed / scheme_not_https; and A 404 OR A REDIRECT, WHICH IS NEVER A STATEMENT THAT A CASE DOES NOT EXIST - it would mean only that this designator does not resolve on this surface at this instant, and the project's absence rule is 'not found in accessible sources'. RING STATUS, STATED SO NO SUCCESSOR INFLATES IT. UNCT/20/6: on this council's own held reduction the covered investment is recorded as a 'Seismic data enterprise' under NAFTA. THAT IS A DATA-ASSET DESIGNATION ON A DOCKET-SUMMARY FIELD AND IT IS NOT AN ESTABLISHED RING-1 PLEADING - no patent, trademark, GI, trade secret or clinical-trial data is pleaded as the covered investment on any body this council has retrieved, and nothing in this batch can establish one; the designation's relevance to the trade-secret / data sub-question is a LEAD for primary-document work the council has never done. ARB/17/19: 'Spice products company' under the China-Germany BIT, with NO IP or data asset in any field this council holds; RING 1 IS NOT ESTABLISHED ON IT and this batch cannot establish it. The register's question is whether movement REACHES THE JURISDICTIONAL GATE ON AN IP OR DATA INVESTMENT, and a null on movement cannot answer it in either direction. CADENCE AND SCOPE: THIS BATCH TOUCHES AND RE-ANCHORS NOTHING ELSE. It is NOT thread 11's search limb (due on or around 2026-10-25, deliberately not pulled forward); it is NOT thread 11's relay row into the Decisions on Manifest Lack of Legal Merit register; it is NOT locked-set row 1-02's forum row; it is NOT the monthly watch on threads 10 or 25 (no 'Wingtech', no 'Yuching'); it does NOT touch ARB/22/2, whose monthly cadence fired yesterday, and it does NOT touch ARB/12/1. STANDING PROHIBITIONS HONOURED: no www.italaw.com or bare italaw.com row; no investmentpolicy.unctad.org or bare unctad.org row; no ARB/24/16 row; no ARB/24/45 row; no dailyjus.com row; no IISD path-family row; no www.bing.com row; no row touching threads 2, 34, 42 or 43; and no caption is named for any unverified matter. Nothing is built by this batch and NO OPERATOR APPROVAL ITEM IS EXERCISED BY IT.

The held window is character-identical across all twelve prior 'Status of Proceeding' rows on nine dates and carries BOTH watched fields in one span: 'Status of Proceeding: Pending Latest Development: December 2, 2025 - Each party files a statement of costs.' In that case it is reported as a DOCKET-SUMMARY FIELD and never as a disposition.

ROW A3 - THE RIGHT-CONTEXT HEDGE on docket A's one watched field, and the gain is stated exactly rather than estimated, per yesterday's sustained objection 1018-C4. Every find anchor sits at offset 100 in its own window (scripts/fetch_relay.py:134-135), so this row's gain over A2 is IDENTICALLY THE INTER-ANCHOR DISTANCE and can never exceed the inter-label gap: on the held 2026-08-13 pair, A2's window begins 'dent(s): Trade Law Bureau' and A3's begins 'bal Affairs Canada', a gap of 29 characters, so this row reaches EXACTLY 29 characters further right than A2 and no more. It is fired anyway and the reason is narrow: if a new and longer development has been posted, 29 characters is the difference between a date plus a truncated clause and a date plus a readable one. Expected HIT (3 fired / 3 TRUE corpus-wide, 1 / 1 on this URL). It is a companion control for A4 and A5 in the same run on the same URL.
